targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "run-Ereignisse" FROM optimizer_requests WHERE "RequestType" = 'run'

panels.title: Optimierer: PV, Verbrauch und Überschuss im Verlauf
panels.description: Intervall-Mittelwerte aus run-Ereignissen; berechneter Überschuss = max(PV verfügbar - Verbrauch laut Optimierer, 0), kein Netzexport.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r."RequestTimestamp", $__interval), avg(r."AvailablePvPowerWatt") AS "PV verfügbar", avg(r."ConsumedPowerWatt") AS "Verbrauch (Optimierer)", avg(r."TotalRequiredPowerWatt") AS "Bedarf", avg(GREATEST(r."AvailablePvPowerWatt" - r."ConsumedPowerWatt", 0)) AS "Überschuss (berechnet)" FROM optimizer_requests r WHERE r."RequestType" = 'run' AND $__timeFilter(r."RequestTimestamp") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Soll-EIN je Optimierer-Lauf
panels.description: Mittlere Anzahl Soll-EIN-Entscheidungen pro run im Zeitintervall, keine tatsächlichen Schaltvorgänge.

targets.rawSql: WITH runs AS (SELECT r."RequestTimestamp" AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE u."ShouldSwitch" IS TRUE) AS on_count FROM optimizer_requests r LEFT JOIN optimizer_request_users u ON u."RequestEntryId" = r."Id" WHERE r."RequestType" = 'run' AND $__timeFilter(r."RequestTimestamp") GROUP BY r."Id", r."RequestTimestamp") SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), avg(on_count)::double precision AS "Soll EIN (Durchschnitt)" FROM runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Soll-Schaltwechsel je Kunde
panels.description: Änderungen von ShouldSwitch zwischen aufeinanderfolgenden run-Ereignissen derselben Session. Keine physisch gemessenen Schaltungen.

targets.rawSql: WITH decisions AS (SELECT r."RequestTimestamp" AS time, u."CustomerId" AS customer_id, u."ShouldSwitch" AS state, lag(u."ShouldSwitch") OVER (PARTITION BY r."SessionId", u."CustomerId" ORDER BY r."RequestTimestamp", r."Id") AS previous FROM optimizer_requests r JOIN optimizer_request_users u ON u."RequestEntryId" = r."Id" WHERE r."RequestType" = 'run' AND u."ShouldSwitch" IS NOT NULL) SELECT c."Name" || ' (' || COALESCE(c."CustomerNumber", c."Id"::text) || ')' AS "Kunde", count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.state IS TRUE AND d.previous IS FALSE) AS "Soll AUS zu EIN", count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.state IS FALSE AND d.previous IS TRUE) AS "Soll EIN zu AUS" FROM decisions d JOIN customers c ON c."Id" = d.customer_id WHERE $__timeFilter(d.time) GROUP BY c."Id", c."Name", c."CustomerNumber" ORDER BY "Soll AUS zu EIN" DESC, "Kunde"

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(f."Timestamp", $__interval), f."Station" AS metric, avg(f."Value") AS value FROM optimizer_field_data f WHERE f."Type" = 'PvYield' AND f."Variable" = 'PowerWatt' AND $__timeFilter(f."Timestamp") GROUP BY 1, f."Station" ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(f."Timestamp", $__interval), f."Station" AS metric, avg(f."Value") AS value FROM optimizer_field_data f WHERE f."Type" = 'StationConsumption' AND f."Variable" = 'PowerWatt' AND $__timeFilter(f."Timestamp") GROUP BY 1, f."Station" ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(f."Timestamp", $__interval), f."Station" AS metric, avg(f."Value") AS value FROM optimizer_field_data f WHERE f."Type" = 'DirectLinePower' AND f."Variable" = 'PowerWatt' AND $__timeFilter(f."Timestamp") GROUP BY 1, f."Station" ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Kundenmesspunkte: Leistung je Kunde
panels.description: CustomerMeter-Rohwerte mit Variable Leistung oder PowerWatt. Für Leistung ist keine Einheit im Nachrichtennamen festgelegt; die Reihen bleiben getrennt.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(f."Timestamp", $__interval), c."Name" || ' (' || COALESCE(c."CustomerNumber", c."Id"::text) || ') / ' || f."Variable" AS metric, avg(f."Value") AS value FROM optimizer_field_data f JOIN customers c ON c."Id" = f."CustomerId" WHERE f."Type" = 'CustomerMeter' AND f."Variable" IN ('Leistung', 'PowerWatt') AND $__timeFilter(f."Timestamp") GROUP BY 1, c."Id", c."Name", c."CustomerNumber", f."Variable" ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sessions im Überblick
panels.description: Alle Sessions; run-Zahlen und Leistungs-Mittelwerte je Session. Nicht mit Energie in kWh verwechseln.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s."CreatedAtUtc" AS "Start", s."EndedAtUtc" AS "Ende", s."SessionId"::text AS "Session-ID", count(r."Id") AS "run-Ereignisse", round(avg(r."AvailablePvPowerWatt")::numeric, 0) AS "PV-Mittel (W)", round(avg(GREATEST(r."AvailablePvPowerWatt" - r."ConsumedPowerWatt", 0))::numeric, 0) AS "Überschuss-Mittel (W)" FROM optimizer_sessions s LEFT JOIN optimizer_requests r ON r."SessionId" = s."SessionId" AND r."RequestType" = 'run' GROUP BY s."SessionId", s."CreatedAtUtc", s."EndedAtUtc" ORDER BY s."CreatedAtUtc" DESC

panels.title: Benötigte Leistung je Kunde (Optimierer)
panels.description: Intervall-Mittelwert von RequiredPowerWatt je Kunde aus run-Ereignissen; unabhängig von der Soll-Schaltentscheidung.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r."RequestTimestamp", $__interval), c."Name" || ' (' || COALESCE(c."CustomerNumber", c."Id"::text) || ')' AS metric, avg(u."RequiredPowerWatt") AS value FROM optimizer_requests r JOIN optimizer_request_users u ON u."RequestEntryId" = r."Id" JOIN customers c ON c."Id" = u."CustomerId" WHERE r."RequestType" = 'run' AND $__timeFilter(r."RequestTimestamp") GROUP BY 1, c."Id", c."Name", c."CustomerNumber" ORDER BY 1
